name: Uyen Luu
description:
My name is Uyen Luu, a passionate software developer with strong experience in modern web and cloud technologies. I specialize in building scalable applications using .NET/.NET Core, Angular, and Azure Cloud, with a strong focus on DevOps practices and cloud-native architectures.

I am a fast learner with a proactive, self-driven mindset, always eager to explore new technologies and improve my skills. I enjoy solving complex problems, designing efficient systems, and delivering reliable solutions that create real value.

My experience spans across full-stack development, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD automation, allowing me to contribute across the entire development lifecycle—from designing APIs and building responsive frontends to deploying and maintaining cloud solutions.

I’m always open to opportunities where I can apply my technical expertise, collaborate with great teams, and continue growing as an engineer.
